title: ERB Lint configuration
markdownDescription:
**ERB Lint** is a tool to help lint your ERB or HTML files using the included linters or by writing your own. Configuration lives in `.erb_lint.yml` at the root of your project.

[GitHub](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint) | [Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#configuration)

enabledByDefault.markdownDescription:
Whether this linter is enabled.

This is a **default linter**, so it is enabled unless `EnableDefaultLinters` is set to `false`.

**Default:** `true`

disabledByDefault.markdownDescription:
Whether this linter is enabled.

This linter is **not** enabled by default.

**Default:** `false`

exclude.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns for files this linter should skip. These are combined with the global `exclude` patterns.

Patterns are matched against both absolute and relative paths with `File.fnmatch?`.

**Example:**
```yaml
exclude:
  - '**/local-lib/**/*'
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#exclude)

rubocopOnly.markdownDescription:
Only run the cops (or departments) listed in this array instead of all cops.

**Example:**
```yaml
only:
  - Style/StringLiterals
  - Layout
```

rubocopConfig.markdownDescription:
A RuboCop configuration hash, in the same format as `.rubocop.yml`. Use `inherit_from` to share your application's RuboCop configuration.

Ignored when `config_file_path` is set.

**Example:**
```yaml
rubocop_config:
  inherit_from:
    - .rubocop.yml
  Layout/InitialIndentation:
    Enabled: false
  Layout/TrailingEmptyLines:
    Enabled: false
```

[RuboCop Configuration](https://docs.rubocop.org/rubocop/configuration.html)

rubocopConfigFilePath.markdownDescription: Path to a RuboCop configuration file. When set, `rubocop_config` is ignored.

customLinter.markdownDescription:
Configuration for a custom linter loaded from the `.erb_linters` directory. Custom linters are disabled by default.

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#custom-linters)

EnableDefaultLinters.markdownDescription:
Enable or disable all of the default linters. Individual linters can still be turned on or off with their own `enabled` option.

**Default:** `true`

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#enable-or-disable-default-linters)

glob.markdownDescription:
Glob pattern for the files to lint when running with `--lint-all`.

**Default:** `**/*.html{+*,}.erb`

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#usage)

exclude.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns for files that every linter should skip.

Prefix patterns with `**/`, since they are matched against the target files' absolute paths.

**Example:**
```yaml
exclude:
  - '**/vendor/**/*'
  - '**/node_modules/**/*'
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#exclude)

inherit_from.markdownDescription:
One or more configuration files to inherit linter settings from. Paths are relative to this file. Settings in this file take precedence.

**Example:**
```yaml
inherit_from:
  - .erb_lint_shared.yml
```

inherit_gem.markdownDescription:
Inherit configuration from files inside installed gems. Each key is a gem name and each value is a path (or list of paths) relative to that gem's root. Gem configuration is applied before `inherit_from` and this file.

**Example:**
```yaml
inherit_gem:
  my_style_gem: config/erb_lint.yml
```

linters.markdownDescription:
Per-linter configuration. Each key is the name of a linter, either built in or a custom linter from the `.erb_linters` directory.

**Example:**
```yaml
linters:
  ErbSafety:
    enabled: true
    better_html_config: .better-html.yml
  Rubocop:
    enabled: true
    rubocop_config:
      inherit_from:
        - .rubocop.yml
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#linters)

AllowedScriptType.markdownDescription:
Prevents the addition of `<script>` tags that have `type` attributes that are not in an allow-list of values.

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#allowedscripttype)

allowed_types.markdownDescription:
The `type` attribute values allowed on `<script>` tags.

**Default:** `["text/javascript"]`

allow_blank.markdownDescription:
Whether the `type` attribute may be omitted from `<script>` tags. When `false`, `<script>` tags without a type are autocorrected to `<script type="text/javascript">`.

**Default:** `true`

disallow_inline_scripts.markdownDescription:
Disallow inline `<script>` tags anywhere in ERB templates.

**Default:** `false`

ClosingErbTagIndent.markdownDescription:
Enforces that a closing ERB tag (`%>`) on its own line is indented to match the opening tag (`<%`), and that a closing tag is on the same line as the opening tag when the opening tag is not followed by a newline.

**Enabled by default.**

CommentSyntax.markdownDescription:
Enforces the correct ERB comment syntax (`<%# comment %>`) rather than Ruby comments inside ERB tags (`<% # comment %>`), which are not valid ERB comments.

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#commentsyntax)

DeprecatedClasses.markdownDescription:
Reports any CSS classes on HTML elements that match a rule set of deprecated classes.

**Example:**
```yaml
DeprecatedClasses:
  enabled: true
  addendum: See UX wiki for help.
  rule_set:
    - deprecated: ['badge[-_\w]*']
      suggestion: Use the ui_badge() component instead.
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#deprecatedclasses)

rule_set.markdownDescription: A list of rules, each with a list of `deprecated` class patterns and a `suggestion` to include in the error message.

deprecated.markdownDescription: A list of **regular expressions** matching the classes deprecated by this rule.

suggestion.markdownDescription: Included in the error message for this rule. Make it informative and specific to the rule.

addendum.markdownDescription: Appended to the end of every error message reported by this linter.

ErbSafety.markdownDescription:
Runs the checks provided by [better-html's ERB safety test helper](https://github.com/Shopify/better-html#testing-for-valid-html-and-erb). Detects unsafe interpolation of Ruby data into JavaScript contexts and enforces safe helpers like `.to_json`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#erbsafety)

better_html_config.markdownDescription: Path to the [better-html configuration file](https://github.com/Shopify/better-html#configuration). The file must exist.

ExtraNewline.markdownDescription:
Reports more than one consecutive blank line.

**Enabled by default.**

FinalNewline.markdownDescription:
Enforces the presence (or absence) of a newline at the end of ERB templates.

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#finalnewline)

present.markdownDescription:
Whether a final newline should be present.

**Default:** `true`

HardCodedString.markdownDescription:
Reports visible hard-coded strings in the DOM. Strings nested inside JavaScript tags are not checked.

**Example:**
```yaml
HardCodedString:
  enabled: true
  corrector:
    path: path/to/corrector_file.rb
    name: I18nCorrector
    i18n_load_path: config/locales/en.yml
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#hardcodedstring)

corrector.markdownDescription: Configures the corrector used to autocorrect offenses. `path`, `name`, and `i18n_load_path` must all be set for autocorrection to run.

path.markdownDescription: Path to the Ruby file that defines the corrector class.

i18n_load_path.markdownDescription: Path to the locale file(s) that strings should be translated into.
Path to the locale file(s) for this linter. The corrector uses `corrector.i18n_load_path`.

NoJavascriptTagHelper.markdownDescription:
Prevents the use of Rails' `javascript_tag` helper, which stops the HTML parser from recognising the change of parsing context. Use a `<script>` tag instead.

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#nojavascripttaghelper)

markdownEnumDescriptions: Wrap the script in `//<![CDATA[` and `//]]>` markers, matching the behaviour of `javascript_tag`

NoUnusedDisable.markdownDescription:
Reports `erb_lint:disable` comments that don't disable any offense.

**Example:**
```erb
<hr /> <%# erb_lint:disable SelfClosingTag %>
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#disable-rule-at-offense-level)

ParserErrors.markdownDescription:
Reports HTML parser errors in ERB templates.

**Enabled by default.**

PartialInstanceVariable.markdownDescription: Reports instance variables used in partials (files whose names start with `_`).

RequireInputAutocomplete.markdownDescription:
Reports `<input>` tags (and Rails form field helpers) of types that support autocomplete but are missing an `autocomplete` attribute.

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#requireinputautocomplete)

RequireScriptNonce.markdownDescription:
Reports `<script>` tags and the `javascript_tag`, `javascript_include_tag` and `javascript_pack_tag` helpers that are missing a [Content Security Policy](https://guides.rubyonrails.org/security.html#content-security-policy) `nonce`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#requirescriptnonce)

RightTrim.markdownDescription:
Enforces a consistent style for trimming at the right of an ERB tag (`-%>` or `=%>`).

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#righttrim)

enforced_style.markdownDescription:
Which right trim style to enforce.

**Default:** `-`

Rubocop.markdownDescription:
Runs RuboCop on the Ruby statements in ERB templates. Each statement is analyzed independently, so cops that need broader context (like `Lint/UselessAssignment`) can report false positives.

**Example:**
```yaml
Rubocop:
  enabled: true
  rubocop_config:
    inherit_from:
      - .rubocop.yml
    Layout/InitialIndentation:
      Enabled: false
    Layout/LineLength:
      Enabled: false
    Layout/TrailingEmptyLines:
      Enabled: false
    Layout/TrailingWhitespace:
      Enabled: false
    Naming/FileName:
      Enabled: false
    Style/FrozenStringLiteralComment:
      Enabled: false
    Lint/UselessAssignment:
      Enabled: false
    Rails/OutputSafety:
      Enabled: false
```

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#rubocop)

RubocopText.markdownDescription: Like the `Rubocop` linter, but only runs RuboCop on ERB tags that appear inside text nodes.

SelfClosingTag.markdownDescription:
Enforces a self-closing tag style for void elements (`area`, `base`, `br`, `col`, `embed`, `hr`, `img`, `input`, `keygen`, `link`, `menuitem`, `meta`, `param`, `source`, `track` and `wbr`).

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#selfclosingtag)

enforced_style.markdownDescription:
Whether void elements should be self-closing.

**Default:** `never`

SpaceAroundErbTag.markdownDescription:
Enforces a single space after `<%` and before `%>`. Tags followed or preceded by a newline are ignored.

**Enabled by default.**

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#spacearounderbtag)

SpaceInHtmlTag.markdownDescription:
Enforces consistent spacing inside HTML tags, such as between attributes and around `=` and `/>`.

**Enabled by default.**

SpaceIndentation.markdownDescription:
Enforces indentation with spaces rather than tabs.

**Enabled by default.**

tab_width.markdownDescription:
The number of spaces to replace each tab with when autocorrecting.

**Default:** `2`

StrictLocals.markdownDescription:
Enforces a [strict locals](https://guides.rubyonrails.org/layouts_and_rendering.html#strict-locals) declaration (`<%# locals: (name:) %>`) in Rails partials.

[Documentation](https://github.com/Shopify/erb_lint#strictlocals)

TrailingWhitespace.markdownDescription:
Reports whitespace at the end of lines.

**Enabled by default.**
